description: Analyze the current PCB from a local JavaScript analysis DSL file. Captures a read-only RoutingBoardV2 snapshot of the selected PCB. Returns operation_id for wait_operation or cancel_operation. The completed result contains analysis status and paths to JSON and PNG artifacts. Instructions and DSL declarations: /scratch/pkg/node_modules/easyeda-copilot-mcp/docs/pcb-analysis.

file.description: Path to a trusted local JavaScript analysis DSL file.

wait_ms.description: Initial wait for a reply. The analysis continues in the background if this wait expires.

name: run_pcb_analysis
title: Run PCB Analysis
